profile.headline: Software Engineering Technical Leader at Cisco
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer at Cisco and a recent graduate (December 2019) of Georgia Tech's Online Master of Science in Computer Science (OMSCS) program. I work for Cisco's StealthWatch Cloud product, for which my primary function is to research and implement multi-cloud security detections.

My preferred programming language is Python. I first used the language in my support role at Cisco, wherein I used it to automate routine support tasks in order to improve service quality. Since then, I have used it to develop machine learning systems, data analysis workflows, scalable cloud applications, and more. I have also worked extensively with other languages and frameworks, including Java, JavaScript, React, and C.

positions.title: Software Engineer (StealthWatch Cloud)
positions.description:
- Develop multi-cloud/enterprise cybersecurity monitoring applications
- Maintain operations and deployments on AWS through devops workflow
- Research and implement new threat detections

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Provided technical support in the digital signage and video space
- Automated known issue detection and solution optimization using Python programming

positions.title: Software Project Engineering Intern
positions.description: - Developed monitor and control software for SCADA systems in proprietary language

positions.title: Systems Integration Engineering Intern
positions.description: - Performed systems integration testing for RF satellite ground systems
